integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands with their back to the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the hips up. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A narrow seam appears along the spine from the base of the neck downward, and small interlocking teeth organise along both sides of it into a perfect living zipper; a small pull tab forms at the nape. <Subject 1> reaches behind the head, finds the tab and slowly pulls it down. The back opens along the centreline, the two sides hinging outward around the ribs like flexible panels, and inside is not anatomy but a dim staircase leading down and away, far deeper than the torso. <Subject 1> stops at the lower back and turns the head over one shoulder toward the camera while the open back stays perfectly still. In the final moment a small light switches on far down inside.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, restrained breathing, a precise zipper sound, the soft separation of the back, and a distant hollow room tone from the impossible interior.
